findings.highlight: Sakura rushes over and pushes me down.
findings.evidenceJa: 駆けつけた桜に念を押されてしまった
findings.governingReading: 駆けつけた桜に念を押される is Sakura rushing over to reinforce her verbal instruction.
findings.explanation: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.

findings.highlight: It's already been a year and a half
findings.governingReading: もうじき一年半 places the threshold shortly ahead.
findings.explanation: Nearly a year and a half becomes already a year and a half.

findings.highlight: I change into the pajamas she brought me.
findings.evidenceJa: 用意してもらった寝巻きを手にとる
findings.governingReading: 寝巻きを手にとる precedes13’s plan to wipe his body and change.
findings.explanation: Picking up the prepared pajamas becomes already changing into them.

findings.highlight: I spent the morning here, and I'm going to feed you dinner, too.
findings.evidenceJa: ここで朝を過ごして、夕方もご飯を食べさせてもらってる
findings.governingReading: Sakura describes receiving hospitality: she spends mornings here and gets to eat dinner here, so cleaning is a reasonable contribution.
findings.explanation: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.

findings.highlight: no matter how awkward it makes you feel.
findings.evidenceJa: どんなに嫌がられても看病する
findings.governingReading: どんなに嫌がられても says he would persist even if she did not want the care.
findings.explanation: Nursing even against her dislike becomes nursing despite awkward feelings.

findings.highlight: we've been tending to the unused rooms without even really thinking about it
findings.evidenceJa: 使わない部屋も気がつけば手入れされていて
findings.governingReading: 気がつけば手入れされていて gives Shirou’s discovery of the upkeep that the next paragraph attributes especially to Sakura.
findings.explanation: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.

findings.highlight: The thermometer inches threateningly towards me, its holder losing her composure.
findings.evidenceJa: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる
findings.governingReading: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる specifies the attempted bodily restraint.
findings.explanation: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.
